play_session_end_state_kind_check.name: play_session_end_state_kind_check
play_session_end_state_kind_check.value: "play_session"."end_state" IS NULL OR ("play_session"."kind" = 'cash' AND "play_session"."end_state" IN ('held', 'cashed_out', 'finished')) OR ("play_session"."kind" = 'tournament' AND "play_session"."end_state" IN ('bagged', 'busted', 'finished'))

play_session_end_stack_required_check.name: play_session_end_stack_required_check
play_session_end_stack_required_check.value: "play_session"."end_stack" IS NOT NULL OR NOT ("play_session"."end_state" IN ('bagged', 'held'))

ledger_line_role_sign_check.name: ledger_line_role_sign_check
ledger_line_role_sign_check.value: ("ledger_line"."role" IN ('buy_in', 'reentry', 'fee', 'chip_purchase', 'addon') AND "ledger_line"."quantity" < 0) OR ("ledger_line"."role" IN ('chip_remove', 'cash_out', 'prize', 'bounty') AND "ledger_line"."quantity" > 0) OR "ledger_line"."role" IN ('adjustment', 'exchange')

ledger_line_role_entry_check.name: ledger_line_role_entry_check
ledger_line_role_entry_check.value: ("ledger_line"."role" IN ('adjustment', 'exchange') AND "ledger_line"."entry_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_line"."effect" = 'real') OR (NOT ("ledger_line"."role" IN ('adjustment', 'exchange')) AND "ledger_line"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_line_play_session_entry_check.name: ledger_line_play_session_entry_check
ledger_line_play_session_entry_check.value: "ledger_line"."play_session_id" IS NULL OR "ledger_line"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL

ledger_line_source_event_scope_check.name: ledger_line_source_event_scope_check
ledger_line_source_event_scope_check.value: "ledger_line"."source_event_id" IS NULL OR ("ledger_line"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_line"."play_session_id" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_line_wallet_links_check.name: ledger_line_wallet_links_check
ledger_line_wallet_links_check.value: NOT ("ledger_line"."role" IN ('adjustment', 'exchange')) OR ("ledger_line"."play_session_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_line"."source_event_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_line"."price_id" IS NULL)

tournament_rule_level_inherited_lineup_c.name: tournament_rule_level_inherited_lineup_check
tournament_rule_level_inherited_lineup_c.value: ("tournament_rule_level"."inherits_lineup" = 1 AND "tournament_rule_level"."inherited_lineup_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tournament_rule_level"."inherited_lineup_id" = "tournament_rule_level"."lineup_id") OR ("tournament_rule_level"."inherits_lineup" = 0 AND "tournament_rule_level"."inherited_lineup_id" IS NULL)
